title: Grammar: Advanced Article Use — Proper Nouns, Abstract Nouns, Discourse
grammarTip:
Продвинутое использование артиклей — контекст важнее правил:

THE с уникальными концептами:
"the government, the media, the internet, the environment"
"the North Pole, the Sahara, the Pacific Ocean"

THE для категорий (особые случаи):
"The whale is an endangered species." (вид в целом)
"She plays the piano." (музыкальные инструменты → the)

НЕТ АРТИКЛЯ с:
Языки: "She speaks English, Russian and Kazakh."
Предметы: "I study law. He teaches medicine."
Маршруты транспорта: "by bus, by train, by plane"
Фразы: "at home, at work, at school, in hospital, in prison"

💡 Когда сомневаешься → the безопаснее чем a, но лучше никакого чем лишний the!

grammarTable.subject: Proper nouns: zero
grammarTable.verb: mountains, lakes, continents, most countries, cities

grammarTable.subject: Abstract + specific

grammarTable.subject: In definitions

grammarTable.short: a = defining; the = referring to the defined

the Nile, the Pacific Ocean, the Alps, the Amazon

rows.form: First mention as a concept (zero), then specific (the)
rows.example: "Inequality is growing. The inequality in this region is particularly severe."

grammarExtra.title: Articles in Academic and Social Writing

rows.example: "This represents a fundamental problem. There is a clear link between poverty and crime."
"The problem requires urgent action. The link has been extensively researched."

rows.form: General statements in social writing: zero
rows.example: "Poverty, inequality, and discrimination are interconnected challenges."

rows.form: Things of which there is only one (in context)
rows.example: the sun, the moon, the sky, the internet, the environment
the government, the economy, the media, the law, the police
the first, the last, the only, the most serious, the least effective
✅ She lives in London. (city: no article)

rows.form: ❌ I visited Kazakhstan and the Netherlands.
rows.example: ✅ I visited Kazakhstan and the Netherlands. (one correct, one needs checking — both OK here!)
✅ Society needs to change. (general concept: zero article)
✅ He works for the United Nations. (organisation with "the")

exercises.text: "___ society needs to address inequality." (General concept)
exercises.hint: "Society" as a general concept: zero article

exercises.instruction: Insert the correct article or write X.
exercises.text: "___ Amazon is ___ longest river in ___ South America."

opts: She works for the United Nations.
She works for an United Nations.
She works for a United Nations.
exercises.correct: She works for the United Nations.

exercises.text: "___ economy has grown, but ___ growth has not reached ___ poorest communities."

exercises.instruction: Which uses the article correctly in academic writing?
opts: There is the clear link between education and income.
There is a clear link between education and income.
There is clear link between education and income.
There is an clear link between education and income.
exercises.correct: There is a clear link between education and income.

exercises.text: "___ media plays ___ crucial role in shaping public opinion."
exercises.hint: "The media" = specific institution; "a crucial role" = first mention
"The environment" = unique, shared concept (only one environment)

exercises.text: "___ government announced ___ new policy on housing. ___ policy will take effect next year."
exercises.hint: "The government" (known); "a new policy" (first mention); "The policy" (second mention)

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct article for this definition.
exercises.text: "Homelessness is ___ complex social issue that affects all countries."
exercises.hint: Defining something: "a complex issue" — one of many

exercises.text: "She grew up in ___ United Kingdom but now lives in ___ Canada."

opts: The poverty is a serious problem.
A poverty is a serious problem.
exercises.hint: Poverty (general abstract): zero; problem (first mention): a

exercises.text: "___ law exists to protect ___ citizens, but ___ law is not always enforced equally."
"This is ___ only solution that has proved effective."

exercises.instruction: Which correctly uses "the" for a national institution?
opts: The government must reform the system.
A government must reform the system.
exercises.correct: The government must reform the system.
exercises.hint: "The government" (known specific); "the system" (specific system in context)

questions.text: "___ society we live in is becoming more unequal." (= a specific society — ours)
questions.hint: "The society we live in" = specific, identified by the relative clause

questions.text: "___ NHS is one of the world's great public health systems." (UK national health service)
"There is ___ link between poverty and crime. ___ link has been well-established."
questions.hint: First mention: a; second mention: the

questions.text: "___ Alps are one of Europe's great mountain ranges."
"The society needs to change" is grammatically correct for a general statement.
questions.hint: "Society" as a general concept = zero article

questions.text: "___ education system in this country needs reform." (= specific system)
questions.hint: "The education system" = specific institution in a specific country

questions.text: "She climbed ___ Everest but had never seen ___ Himalayas from above."
"This is ___ first time the issue has been raised in parliament."
"___ unemployment has risen. ___ unemployment rate is now at 8%."
questions.hint: Unemployment (general): zero; "the unemployment rate" (specific measure): the
